source_snapshot.items: Test SSIF connection between FPGA and BMC I2C-1
source_snapshot.procedure: From OS run `sudo ipmitool bmc info` and require success.
source_snapshot.criteria: No SSIF transport attribution or expected identity-field oracle.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; invents physical probing/soldering despite read-only host command.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Notes path attribution gap but incorrectly makes physical probing primary.

old_problem: Generic ipmitool success does not prove FPGA-to-BMC I2C-1 SSIF rather than KCS/BT/LAN/another device; OS driver/node mapping, no-fallback proof, response fields and transport error limits are absent.
disposition_reason: The request is low-risk/read-only and can be automated after platform mapping, so Manual Only is incorrect. ED-03 nevertheless prohibits guessing the OEM SSIF path. Pending/Requires Confirmation remains until the chosen local interface, identity fields and no-fallback evidence are authoritative.
decision_basis: Read row129/history2519 and preserved the unique FPGA/BMC I2C-1 SSIF path rather than generic BMC reachability.
Preserved OS execution and literal `sudo ipmitool bmc info`.
Rejected invented board probing/solder/photos as core acceptance.
Required device-node/driver/interface mapping, expected identity fields and transport-specific counter/log deltas with no alternate fallback.
No sudo command, driver change, retry, BMC reset, physical probe or DUT action occurred.

test_case.purpose: Obtain valid BMC information through the specifically mapped host local SSIF interface that traverses FPGA and BMC I2C-1, excluding KCS/BT/LAN/alternate fallback and showing no new transport errors.
required_package: Platform diagram mapping selected OS IPMI device through FPGA to BMC I2C-1 SSIF
Driver/module and `/dev/ipmi*` or equivalent interface identity
Approved ipmitool build/interface option and sudo policy
No-fallback method plus SSIF/I2C/FPGA counters/logs and timeout/retry limits
test_case.test_command: After approval, capture driver/device-node/interface and SSIF/I2C/FPGA baseline, invoke one bounded `sudo ipmitool bmc info` through the explicit owner-approved local interface, preserve stdout/stderr/status/duration, compare identity fields and transport deltas, and do not retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: The mapped SSIF interface returns all signed BMC identity fields within timeout, platform evidence proves traversal through FPGA/BMC I2C-1 with no alternate fallback, and SSIF/I2C/FPGA counters/logs show no unacceptable new error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires response content plus transport attribution. Generic ipmitool success, default-interface assumption, wrong identity, fallback, timeout, nonzero exit or error delta beyond policy fails; physical probing is not required absent separate scope.
safety_gate: Approve explicit local interface and minimal sudo scope.
Do not unload drivers, change routing or reset BMC.
Bound timeout and capture first failure once without retry masking intermittency.
test_case.recovery: No state change is expected. If the bounded read fails, preserve logs/counters and stop; do not switch interfaces, reload drivers or reset BMC automatically. Owner investigates mapping/transport before any repeat.

source_conflict.reason: Specific SSIF path is not proven by the generic command and Criteria lacks fields; prior reviews add unsupported physical-only work.

blocked.reason: The read-only functional method is known; platform interface mapping and oracle are resolvable confirmation prerequisites.
